stance: refutes (seed premise is moot) / supports no-chitin-binding
key_finding: Natural and Pichia-secreted recombinant Der p 23 both failed to interact with chitin matrices in vitro
context: D. pteronyssinus fecal pellet extract + P. pastoris rDer p 23, chitin matrix binding
confidence_limitations: High for the negative result; no positive control reported in the abstract

claim_tested: Does Der p 23 bind chitin, and what is its fold?
key_finding: X-ray/NMR structure is a small globular protein with two disulphide bonds; functional assays failed to confirm chitin binding
context: Recombinant Der p 23, X-ray crystallography (PDB 4ZCE, 1.55 A) and NMR
confidence_limitations: High for the structure; assay details not in the abstract

claim_tested: Where is Der p 23 and is it a chitin-binding protein?
key_finding: Immunogold EM localises it to the peritrophic matrix of the midgut and the fecal pellet surface; chitin binding asserted from peritrophin sequence homology only
context: D. pteronyssinus midgut, immunogold electron microscopy
confidence_limitations: High for localization; the chitin-binding claim is inference, not assay

claim_tested: Has Der p 23 lost its exposed aromatics?
key_finding: 8 of 10 aromatic rings have >=15 A2 exposed ring surface; total 423 A2 = 881 A2 per 100 residues vs 1014 (tachycitin) and 439 (ChBD-ChiA1)
context: Heavy-atom Shrake-Rupley, 1.4 A probe, 960 sphere points
confidence_limitations: Direct computation; depends on the crystal conformation and excludes the disordered 22-42 segment

claim_tested: Is Der p 23 aromatic-depleted relative to mite CBM14 relatives?
key_finding: Der p 23 has the highest aromatic density of 8 domains tested (16.7% F/W/Y) and exceeds Blo t 12 and Lep d 12 (8.0%) and Der p 18 (12.5%)
context: UniProt sequences aligned on the canonical 6-Cys CBM14 register
confidence_limitations: Direct computation; register anchoring rather than a full MSA, EBI Clustal Omega was unavailable

claim_tested: What does Der p 23 actually lack?
key_finding: 4 of 6 canonical cysteines: C2 is His61 and C6 is absent; Der f 23 and Blo t 12 keep C2, Der p 18 keeps all six
context: UniProt L7N6F8, A0A088SAW7, Q17282, Q1M2L5, Q4JK70, Q4JK71
confidence_limitations: Direct computation; register assignment is inferred from spacing, not from an experimental disulfide map for the relatives

claim_tested: Does Der p 23 differ electrostatically from chitin binders?
key_finding: Core net -4.12 (pI 4.62), mature -10.02 (pI 4.02) vs tachycitin +3.59 and ChBD-ChiA1 +0.97
confidence_limitations: Correlation across 8 domains; no chitin-bound CBM14 structure exists to show a positive face is required

key_finding: No non-Cys position is both >=75% conserved across 40 paralogs and >30% exposed; the conserved exposed feature is an acidic patch D56/P57/D59/E84/D85/T88 with F54 on its rim
